e7_s3: Pancreatic involvement in IgG4-related disease with inflammatory bowel disease
e7_s4_rationale: Elevated serum IgG4, pancreatic swelling, and duct narrowing on imaging studies are consistent with IgG4-related pancreatitis, and the presence of extensive ulcerative colitis suggests a possible association with IgG4-related disease

e7_s4_rejected.label: Autoimmune pancreatitis
e7_s4_rejected.why: While similar to IgG4-related pancreatitis, the specific diagnosis of autoimmune pancreatitis is not as strongly supported by the combination of elevated IgG4 and imaging findings

e7_s4_rejected.label: Acute pancreatitis
e7_s4_rejected.why: The lack of abdominal pain and normal white-cell count do not support a diagnosis of acute pancreatitis

e7_s4_rejected.label: Chronic pancreatitis
e7_s4_rejected.why: The absence of long-term pancreatic damage or calcifications on imaging makes chronic pancreatitis less likely

e7_s4_rejected.label: Pancreatic involvement in IgG4-related disease with inflammatory bowel disease
e7_s4_rejected.why: While this option considers the patient's inflammatory bowel disease, IgG4-related pancreatitis is a more specific diagnosis that directly addresses the pancreatic findings
